kind: growth-trading 1.3.0 parity baseline (breakout entry, initial risk stop, trend retention; gates and continuation OFF and ON)
numberEncoding: JSON numbers are exact doubles; NaN and ±Infinity are the strings "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity"

attribution.note: Descriptive attribution: each trade is credited to the mechanism that opened it. This is NOT the incremental (causal) effect of enabling a mechanism: enabling it changes which later signals are taken and so the whole trade sequence. The causal comparison is a complete ON run against an otherwise identical OFF run (path-dependent counterfactual).

optionalRules.note: Descriptive counts of one run, not the effect of a rule: a stop, a breakout entry or a retained remainder changes every later decision (path dependence). Compare a complete ON run with an otherwise identical OFF run. Retrospective historical data only; the defaults are starting hypotheses, not optimised values.

initialStop.atrConvention: simple mean of the true ranges (max(high, previous close) − min(low, previous close)) of the L sessions completed before the fill session

retention.classification: a position is ONE closed trade when its last share is sold, a win or a loss by its total net (all its fills); partial fills are reported separately

trendFilter.note: blockedByDecisionKind counts every blocked evaluation (a latched opportunity is evaluated at each completed bar while it waits)

Retrospective historical data only; not evidence that a rule makes trading safer.
